messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout requested for service `embeddings-eu1` -> prod-eu1. Patch: reduce KV cache pressure after recent quantization change. Change window: immediate (10m prep). Owner: nina. Runbook: <https://go/internal/runbooks/embeds-kvcache>|runbook

nina: TL;DR: memory spike + K/V churn caused transient 503s after the quant path. Patch reduces in-memory cache size and adjusts eviction thresholds; validated in staging with repro load. Need expedited ops lane for prod push.

leo: Ack. What's the rollback plan if we see regression? Ops-lead to confirm rollback commands and criteria.

ops-lead: Rollback (tested in staging):
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/embeds-eu --to-revision=3
# restore previous replica count: kubectl scale deploy/embeds-eu --replicas=6
```
Abort criteria: >5% 5xx for 5m or sustained memory >80% on canary nodes. Canary policy requires 2 engineer approvals + ops-lead OK.

sarah: +1 for expedited, provided we keep canary at 5-10% for 15m with dashboards and paging alerts enabled. I'll watch 503/latency. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Expedited approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-apply in 5m if 2 approvers (excluding deploy-bot).

mike: :thumbsup: +1

jen: :thumbsup: +1 — I'll be pager on-duty for 20m post-deploy and will escalate on any >2% error rate.

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached (2 approvals + ops-lead consent). Initiating canary rollout now.

deploy-bot: Rolling out:
```
Image: registry.redwood/embeds:hotfix-kv-2026-03-23-a
Canary -> 10% traffic to pool-eu-canary
Target nodes: node-pool-eu-1 (ssd-optimized)
```

nina: Drafting release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/hotfix-embeds-2026-03-23 — includes RCA, mitigation, and rollback snippet.

sarah: Metrics updating — canary 503s down from 4.2% -> 0.4% within 3m. Nice. :white_check_mark:

jen: Observability looks stable. Recommend increasing canary to 50% after 10m if no regressions and keep on-call pinned.

mike: Agree. Also route traffic to model pin `v1.3-quant-safe` during full rollout to avoid alternate quant path.

ops-lead: Model pin applied at routing layer. Reminder: if errors spike >5% in any 5m window, abort and rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 50%. Full rollout will proceed after a 20m stable window unless abort is triggered.

nina: Thanks all — updating release note with timings and final rollback commands. Leaving thread open for post-rollout verification.

jen: Post-check after full rollout: 20m stable. 99p latency unchanged, error rate at 0.2%. Ending pager watch in 10m. :tada:
